name: Ankle Circle
steps: Sit comfortably on the floor or a chair and lift one foot slightly so the ankle can move freely.
Trace slow, wide circles with your toes, moving through your full comfortable ankle range in one direction.
Reverse direction partway through for the target duration, then lower that foot and switch sides.
tips: Keep your knee and shin still so all movement comes strictly from the ankle joint.
Move slowly enough to feel every edge of the circle rather than spinning your foot loosely.
